why: Multiple post-snapshot papers directly address the conjecture's own bound m for K_M ⊗ L^{⊗m}: Ghidelli-Lacini give an n log log(n) bound (building on their 2021 preprint, journal version 2024), and arXiv:2609.01574 (Sept 2026) by Jingjun Han claims 'A linear bound for Fujita's freeness conjecture,' a substantial improvement on the effective bound for the exact quantity in the statement.
